profile.bio: I currently have over 40 years of experience in analytical instrument and method development, organic pollutant monitoring, elemental analysis, and trace metal analysis. Through various positions in academia, government, industry, and nonprofits, I have taught, supported, advised, and collaborated with students, scientists, and other professionals on a wide variety of chemical and environmental analysis applications.
